notes.title: Dungeons Deep Update - Chapter I
notes.notes:
This patch paves the road for a three chapter main update, that could even be considered as an expansion of sorts.

The first Chapter brings to us the Webveil Hollow instance, along lots of riches and some new materials and items. Some important notes towards those are the Ember Wand that shoots fireballs, three drafts that have various functions, one bringing home decorations for example, the other two enabling a foodstuff or a material.

The foodstuff being called Cozonak, with a big replenish pool and the material is Noble Fabric that will be linked to future utilities in-game.

This update has a divination action (  key ) tweak and two new achievements regarding the instance, along other fixes and tweaks.

To be noted that Webveil Hollow is reeking with broodkins and their relatives but holds great treasures as the ones in the beginning of this post.

On an ending note, please consider reviewing the game and letting me know more of your insights on the project's discord server. Also, if there are missing links in-game or bugs, I'll try to cover them ASAP.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Winter Update v1.10b6 Open Beta
notes.notes:
Another day, another update. <3

There are yet some small bugs that wear off by double tapping the ESC key such as the cursor/camera misbehavior sometimes when exiting UI elements, and the more persistent ones that refresh after a cold save & load. I do try to fix them in time but sometimes what a dev wants to do is tackled by what a dev can do. Some things will be fixed later due some used frameworks limiations that I'm trying to overcome.

Until then, if you find anything that's gamebreaking / persistent and I haven't managed to fix yet, please report either on Steam Discussions / Discord group as a reminder, or something I haven't encountered yet.

If the game starts misbehaving with this new Winter Update that you haven't yet installed, please do a fresh save. As an ending note, if you see the game is indeed weird, maybe I've messed something up with an update and please check for a new update asap. Hopefully I won't need to update the game again today and just prepare for the upcoming week.

Take care!

Sincerely,
Musbrich.
